About.name: I'm Nahuel
About.intro: I'm Nahuel, a full-stack developer who started out as a physics teacher and electronics engineering student. That's why I build products that connect people with knowledge — like the tutoring platform Entienda y Aprenda — alongside data-driven tools such as Torino City Intelligence, always exploring how AI makes development faster and products smarter.
About.goalsText: Keep building products that solve real problems for real people — and keep learning how AI lets a small team ship what used to take a big one.
